INSERT INTO ecom_settlement_item (settlement_id, posted_date, item_type, platform_order_no, seller_sku, amount, description, raw_type, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{i.settlementId}, #{i.postedDate}, #{i.itemType}, #{i.platformOrderNo}, #{i.sellerSku}, #{i.amount}, #{i.description}, #{i.rawType}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT platform_order_no AS "platformOrderNo", item_type AS "itemType", SUM(amount) AS amount FROM ecom_settlement_item WHERE settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND platform_order_no IS NOT NULL AND platform_order_no <> '' GROUP BY platform_order_no, item_type

SELECT si.* FROM ecom_settlement_item si JOIN ecom_settlement st ON st.id = si.settlement_id WHERE si.settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND (si.platform_order_no IS NULL OR si.platform_order_no = '' OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ecom_order o WHERE o.store_id = st.store_id AND o.platform_order_no = si.platform_order_no)) ORDER BY si.id
